scope: Bounded official-source inventory for Excelsior University: only bachelor's programs whose current program page, transfer guide and November 2026 catalog section were captured. Listings and transfer-policy evidence are separate from course-by-course degree maps.

accreditation.institutional: Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE)

pricing.notes: $510 per credit hour for undergraduate courses, plus a $40 per credit hour Academic Services Fee, a $28 per course credit Technology Fee and a one-time $125 graduation fee. Partner, military, nursing and BS in Business fixed-rate pricing differ.

institutional.notes: Each captured bachelor's program page states 'Transfer up to 113 Credits'. Outside credit needs the equivalent of C- or higher and is posted as Pass; program pages and the catalog name required Excelsior courses (Information Literacy, Cornerstone and the capstone). Students admitted through a partnership after December 31, 2024 must complete at least 15 Excelsior course credits.
institutional.applicability: Bachelor's programs listed here; nursing and technology programs have additional restrictions that are not imported.

ace.notes: Excelsior reserves the right to evaluate and accept or deny ACE- and NCCRS-recommended non-collegiate credit, which must be completed during the recommendation period. Course-by-course partner guides for Sophia, Study.com and StraighterLine are published separately; no separate non-collegiate credit ceiling was found for these programs.

nccrs.notes: Evaluated under the same Non-Collegiate Sources of Credit policy as ACE recommendations.

coverage.completeFor: Three bachelor's programs whose program page, transfer guide and November 2026 catalog section were captured: BS in Business, BS in Psychology and BS in Liberal Arts.
gaps: Other Excelsior associate, bachelor's, nursing, technology and graduate programs are not imported yet.
Concentration-specific BS in Business and BS in Liberal Arts course maps are not modeled; the reviewed course maps use the published No Concentration option.

programs.notes: Asynchronous online program. The program page states transfer up to 113 credits.
